variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one square transparent PNG avatar for AIDE, a small helpful assistant inside Imperial Ops, a calm greyscale operations dashboard.
Style/medium: beautifully art-directed stylised 3D character render with practical retro-futurist Star Wars prop design, physical matte metal and softly worn enamel, premium restrained product mascot, very simple bold shapes that survive at 28-36 pixels.
Composition: one single character only, centred large isolated head / compact upper body portrait occupying about 80 percent of square canvas, slight three-quarter turn towards viewer, plenty of safe margin so antenna tips aren't cut, character fills frame equally in width and height. No circular badge, no lettering, no UI, no surrounding props or scenery.
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse studio light, gentle rim for readability against both near-black and pale grey backgrounds; calm, competent, curious and approachable, not threatening, not overly cute.
Colour palette: strictly neutral monochrome, charcoal graphite, pewter, silver grey, softly aged light grey enamel. Neutral white lens reflections only. No blue, no cyan, no coloured lights or glow. All parts including eyes greyscale.
Background: actual transparent alpha, no floor, no shadow behind subject, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: clean silhouette, low detail density, avoid tiny greebles, no human skin, no weapons, no text, no logos, no watermark.
Subject: AIDE Scout. A friendly compact hovering Imperial scout droid inspired by Star Wars ID9 seeker and probe droids. One oversized glossy black optical eye in a recessed brushed pewter circular socket, asymmetrical rounded graphite head shell with a single short off-centre antenna, softly squared lower casing with two little tucked cheek panels that suggest attentive ears. Smallest possible torso. The eye catches a quiet soft silver glint. Head has a subtle curious tilt. Broad black central lens and strong lighter outer shell make an instantly readable cyclopean face. NO long dangling arms or tentacles. Keep it a friendly little workmate.

Subject: AIDE Protocol. An approachable Star Wars K-2SO-inspired compact protocol droid HEAD AND TOP OF SHOULDERS portrait. Tall gently tapered rounded charcoal head with a broad softly rounded brow, TWO widely spaced small round silver glass optical eyes in dark recessed sockets, subtle off-centre head tilt and short narrow neck. Muted pewter cheek plates and a restrained simple mouth vent lend a dry understated personality. Graphite shoulders just visible at bottom. Sophisticated soft-edged industrial design, watchful and dependable, no menacing scowl. Simple memorable silhouette, no exposed wires.

Subject: AIDE Co-pilot. A friendly Star Wars BD-1-inspired little exploration droid HEAD AND SHORT NECK portrait. Horizontal binocular / compact camera-shaped head with two big black circular optics, one subtly bigger than the other, set in two rounded light-grey enamel housings joined by a small charcoal bridge. Head has a gentle curious tilt, two short stubby antennae angled slightly back, a tiny graphite articulated neck and cropped shoulder base below. Pewter edge guards, small panel seams, soft worn enamel. Reads as an alert thoughtful companion, not a pair of glasses, NOT a human, NOT a body or full walking robot. Simple bold shapes and large black lenses, neutral silver reflections.
